caseNameFull: O'Neill v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co.
attorneys: C. Richard Orieser argued the cause and filed a brief for petitioner., Robert F. Ebinger argued the cause for respondent. With him on the brief were E. H. Burgess, Kenneth H. Ekin and Arvin J. Alexander.

opinions.text:
Certiorari, 348 U. S. 812, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The judgment of the Court of Appeals is reversed and the ease is remanded to the District Court with instructions to reinstate its order dated July 30, 1952.
